answer: To cross the bridge into the network, nodes cannot operate as an isolated island; each must lock dynamic deposits subject to cryptographic stake burning. Under quadratic identity pricing, minting $k$ coordinated identities requires burning resources scaling superlinearly as $\mathcal{O}(k^2)$. Inactive or malicious actors face exponential slash decay resembling a melting glacier, making mass Sybil swarms mathematically unviable.
